Hello, good morning! Mujhe ek loan account close karna hai, uske regarding baat karni thi. Actually, mujhe recently office mein bonus mila hai, toh main apne saare remaining loan EMIs ek hi baar mein prepay karke account ko close karna chahta hoon. 

Can you please check the exact outstanding amount, aur yeh batao ki koi prepayment charges lagenge kya? Plus, mujhe loan department se connect kar do kyunki prepayment ke liye shayad kuch special processing chahiye hogi.
